canon.note: Skill Transcendent Flash (1121202) Ice DMG #1 L10 = 150% of ATK. Ultimate Florephemeral Dreamflux (1121203) Ice DMG #1 L10 = 180% of ATK, adjacent #3 = 90%. Enhanced Skill Moon On Glacial River (1121209): Notes — DMG dealt in 5 hits (10% + 10% + 10% + 20% + 50%); #1 L10 = 150% of ATK on the primary target, #3 = 75% adjacent; entering the state requires #5 = 2 Syzygy stacks, the Ultimate's entry advances the action by #6 = 100% (1121204), and the Moonlight buff grants CRIT DMG +#3 = 44% per stack (observed 5 stacks, cap #4 = 2.2) plus CRIT Rate +#7 = 50% (jingliu_spectral). Enhanced Skill does not consume Skill Points. Frost Wraith (bonus): at Syzygy cap the next attack ignores 25% of the target's DEF (_jw6). Energy limit 140.

requirements.claim: Talent Syzygy: the stack counter rises as allies take action — logged 'Syzygy N → M' (destruction.ts:890-915).
Transcendent Flash (1121202) is Jingliu's base Skill; the fixture casts it 2 times (single-hit → 2 damage events).
Florephemeral Dreamflux (1121203) is Jingliu's Ultimate action; cast twice.

Moon On Glacial River (1121209) is the state's Enhanced Skill — the only Skill available in the Moonlight state, and it does not consume Skill Points. It is emitted as a Skill action (never 'basic'): the fixture's 6 Skill ABILITY_USED are 2 base Transcendent Flash + 4 Enhanced Moon casts.
Jingliu's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; never a generic attack action.
Moon On Glacial River Notes: DMG dealt in 5 hits (10% + 10% + 10% + 20% + 50%); 4 casts in the fixture = 20 events on the primary target.
Moon On Glacial River's final hit is 50% of #1 = 75% of ATK at L10 (last of the 10/10/10/20/50 split).
Moon On Glacial River's adjacent targets take #3 = 75% of ATK at L10.
Transcendent Flash (1121202) #1 = 150% of ATK at L10.
Florephemeral Dreamflux (1121203) #1 = 180% of ATK at L10 on the primary target.
Florephemeral Dreamflux's adjacent targets take #3 = 90% of ATK at L10.
Transcendent Flash costs 1 SP per cast (2 casts = 2 SP); the Enhanced Skill Moon On Glacial River is free (canon: does not consume Skill Points).
Florephemeral Dreamflux uses the standard Energy ladder (140); this rotation regenerates exactly 253 Energy.
Entering the Moonlight state applies jingliu_spectral (permanent while the state is active).
1121204 #7: entering the state raises CRIT Rate by 50% at L10 (jingliu_spectral).
Moonlight (jingliu_moon) tracks the Moon On Glacial River stacks while the state is active.

1121204 #3: each Moonlight stack grants CRIT DMG +44% at L10; observed 5 stacks (cap #4) = 2.2. Enemy attacks mint their own attackSeq, so each attack received by the solo carry counts once (5 reached in the 3-cycle fixture).
1121204 #6 = 100% at L10: entering the state via the Ultimate advances Jingliu's action by 100% (canon value, not a deviation).
Frost Wraith (bonus): at Syzygy cap the next attack applies a mark that ignores 25% of the target's DEF (_jw6).
The Frost Wraith mark lands before the next Moon On Glacial River damage resolves.
Entering the state (spectral buff) precedes the first Moon On Glacial River damage.
Basic ATK Lucent Moonglow is Jingliu's only non-Skill action: out of the Moonlight state it is chosen once the shared SP pool hits 0 (destruction.ts:820-825).
